download_dodecadialogue_models: download pretrained Dialogue Dodecathlon models and dictionary files to the specified datapath directory
download_model_by_name: download a specific dodecadialogue model by name using the download function with datapath and model_name
check_model_built_status: check whether a dodecadialogue model directory has already been built using the built function
get_model_directory: get the model directory path for dodecadialogue models using get_model_dir with the datapath
download_models_with_version: download model tarballs with version tracking using download_models from parlai core build_data
